setup.settingMethod: Existing public DOM controls and their change/click handlers; fixed still, not native driving

observation.measurementModel: sampled uniform bounded noise, deterministic Mulberry32, zero-order-hold delay
observation.channels: flight position / attitude / velocity feedback; wheel speed and contact switches remain ideal

currentPoseTrim.scope: zero velocity, zero angular velocity, gravity wrench only; no aerodynamic, valve-lag or transient recovery certificate

levelTargetTrim.scope: zero velocity, zero angular velocity, gravity wrench only; no aerodynamic, valve-lag or transient recovery certificate

controlAuthority.boundMeaning: independent-axis bounds; not simultaneously achievable, valve lag and allocation coupling remain

pilotIntent.scope: Accepted controller request only. Saturation, valve lag, finite supply and contact can prevent the requested motion.

state.altitudeDatum: 重心至世界竖直向下最近碰撞面的距离

horizon.collision: Existing 620 m physical perimeter and 700 m working limit; shared banks join the floor to distant scenery.

indirectLighting.algorithm: Offline 3-bounce diffuse path tracing / spatial order-2 SH

nightIndirectLighting.algorithm: Fixture cone quadrature → first static envelope hit → cosine diffuse virtual source → visible probe; nonnegative six-axis ambient-cube storage
nightIndirectLighting.source: One diffuse surface event, 24 deterministic cone samples per fixture, finite 22 m virtual-source influence, six-axis ambient-cube angular approximation and closed static envelopes. No direct light, daylight, emission-only signs or car headlamps are baked.

nightDirectLighting.algorithm: Stationary fixture intensity/range/cone → static visibility → six-axis direct diffuse irradiance; separate from retained one-bounce transport
nightDirectLighting.source: One diffuse surface event, 24 deterministic cone samples per fixture, finite 22 m virtual-source influence, six-axis ambient-cube angular approximation and closed static envelopes. No direct light, daylight, emission-only signs or car headlamps are baked.
nightDirectLighting.transport: Static direct diffuse with complementary live blend

blend.scope: Static city diffuse; car/headlights remain dynamic; real spot specular is retained.
blend.limits: Far shadows use the 4/8 m static envelope field. The transition blends two lighting approximations; moving-car shadows are retained in the near live region, not in the far baked region.

lightingDiagnostics.selectionAnchor: Main viewing camera, including fixed and paused views

practicals.policy: Main camera ground coverage, 20% selection hysteresis, one occupied-slot crossfade at a time, 2/3/4 bounded shadowed fixtures. Static bounced diffuse stays continuous between direct-light pools.

nightField.algorithm: Fixture cone quadrature → first static envelope hit → cosine diffuse virtual source → visible probe; nonnegative six-axis ambient-cube storage
nightField.source: One diffuse surface event, 24 deterministic cone samples per fixture, finite 22 m virtual-source influence, six-axis ambient-cube angular approximation and closed static envelopes. No direct light, daylight, emission-only signs or car headlamps are baked.

nightDirectField.algorithm: Stationary fixture intensity/range/cone → static visibility → six-axis direct diffuse irradiance; separate from retained one-bounce transport
nightDirectField.source: One diffuse surface event, 24 deterministic cone samples per fixture, finite 22 m virtual-source influence, six-axis ambient-cube angular approximation and closed static envelopes. No direct light, daylight, emission-only signs or car headlamps are baked.
nightDirectField.transport: Static direct diffuse with complementary live blend

blend.scope: Static city diffuse; car/headlights remain dynamic; real spot specular is retained.
blend.limits: Far shadows use the 4/8 m static envelope field. The transition blends two lighting approximations; moving-car shadows are retained in the near live region, not in the far baked region.

roadSurface.wetness: Damp aggregate remains rough; sparse shallow puddles collect near road edges and repair depressions. Wheel tracks drain first. Visual wetness does not alter tyre friction.
roadSurface.streetScale: Canonical 10/18/22 m route widths; repair joints follow the nearest street direction rather than a world-aligned tile grid.
roadSurface.planarReflection: One clipped low-resolution ground-plane capture in the benchmark district, budgeted only in high/ultra; no SSR/ray-tracing claim.
roadSurface.assumptions: Scanned asphalt with authored repair/water distribution. Water depth, drainage and optical properties are visual engineering estimates.

surfaces.uvContract: Local face UV multiplied by each instance metre dimensions; independent of world yaw.
surfaces.normalContract: Cotangent frame with UV determinant, tangent length and normal length guards.
surfaces.fineDetail: Derivative-filtered, with an additional distance fade; no displacement.

scene.daylight: CC0 measured midday sky / calibrated sun + baked diffuse

practicalLights.policy: Main camera ground coverage, 20% selection hysteresis, one occupied-slot crossfade at a time, 2/3/4 bounded shadowed fixtures. Static bounced diffuse stays continuous between direct-light pools.

wetRoadReflection.algorithm: Bounded perspective + oblique ground clip + dedicated conservative distance cull; five-tap spatial filter
wetRoadReflection.refreshPolicy: Camera/lens, visible vehicle transforms/deformations and selected practical state invalidate the capture within the existing 12/20 Hz caps; a static scene reuses it for 0.35 s. Spatial fade stays inside the original domain.
wetRoadReflection.scope: Only y≈0 inside the authored route district; high/ultra presets only. No SSR, ray tracing or wet-fluid simulation.

renderBudget.probeShadowMode: Dedicated local sun depth; one physical direct sun in cube faces

probeSun.algorithm: Local orthographic packed depth; 4 depth comparisons in cube capture only
probeSun.limits: Finite local capture volume; opaque geometry shadowing. Transparent transmission and dynamic GI are not solved.

device.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

performance.measurement: Actual browser rAF frame intervals including long frames; CPU submission timings; optional nonblocking WebGL GPU query results counted once each. Loading duration is separate from active warmup and steady-state capture. No actual GPU sample is inferred from draw calls, CPU time or an unavailable timer.
